brief: Global markets rebounded as the U.S. Treasury eased bond market stress, while Fed minutes revealed growing impatience with inflation. Politically, Trump's FDA pick drew criticism, and North Korea cast doubt on U.S. talks, as Canada-U.S. trade deal details remained murky. Research highlights include MRI diagnostic advances and social dynamics studies.
news_summary: U.S. Treasury bond buyback boosted markets, but Fed minutes showed more officials favoring rate hikes. Trump's FDA nominee faced backlash, and Kim Yo-jong dismissed U.S.-North Korea talks, while Canada and the U.S. edged toward a trade deal.
papers_summary: Research covers medical imaging (CE-T2 FLAIR MRI value), neuroimmune HLA polymorphism, and social status dynamics in rural Colombia, alongside LLM writing disengagement and plant stress tolerance.
